hook: Contractors: can you pass this *COI* quiz?
title: Certificate of insurance *quiz* for contractors

questions.q: A client asks for your COI. What are they really checking?
questions.why: A COI is proof your policies are in force on the dates shown.

questions.q: Your general liability policy renews next month. Is your old COI still good after that?
options: No, it shows the old dates
questions.why: Each COI lists policy dates. After renewal, clients often ask for a fresh one.

questions.q: Who usually notices an expired COI first?
questions.why: Often it's the client, right before they hold a payment or pull you off a job.

cta.title: Never chase a COI again
cta.body: CertTrack tracks every policy and license and alerts you before anything expires.
